[b][u]Nordiheim Department of Foreign Relations:[/u][/b]
 
The department of foreign relations have today desided to send inquiries to the two nations of The Secound Flousech Republic to the far west and The Confederacy og Pantagruel to the east to seek permission to send diplomats for the establishment of embassies and potential trade of goods, services and resources.

While these nations do not necessearly have the strongest or most established economies, with Flousechs industrila base having been ravaged by war, Nordiheim sees them as nations with great potential for fast ecconomic growth and expansion.

Especialy Pantaguel with its large deposits of nearly untouched resources inside their borders that could be used to potentialy  create a economic boom now that it is turning democratic and more open, though not without a healty dose of caution to prevent itself being missused.
They might even be interested in buying military hardware to compliment or upgrade their military?, its definitly worth checking atleast.

Meanwhile the Flousechian nation, who have managed to throw of the cains of royal oppression to gain freedom, have allready been in contact with Nordiheim in the past to buy and recive military weapons and vehicles, perhaps they could be a potential buyer again?

For now though Nordiheim can only wait for a reply.

[quote=pantagruel;60404274][i][b]The giant gazes westwards[/b][/i][/quote]
Many many objections would arise at the cancellation of negotiations and the detention of the leaders of the factions that had attended. Guoing Loka of the Amarallo peoples army would simply follow whatever the pantagruelis said, knowing that cooperation with them would be vital to the survival of his faction, despite the fact that Pantagruel had in some ways betrayed them, by invading and seizing the islands. The Democrats and tribal leaders however, would be less than cooperative.

Haru arono, now representing the splinter free Astaniran front after the Kuwalkti incident, would at first object loudly against being kept in pantagruel. He is known for fighting alongside his men in the frontlines, not just sitting back like every other leader. Eventually, he would quieten down, realising that his objections would do nothing, but he would be sure to never cooperate with the pantagruelis, suspecting they would try to take advantage of the dire situation in his homeland, just as Qianxun had.

The tribal leaders would also be stubborn, yet less vocal about their objections. After they received intelligence from Nordiheim before they left for Teremok, they would place a deep mistrust in Pantagruel, fearing that they would be the same as Qianxun, just like Haru.

None of the tribal leaders would agree to sign into the UDF, placing a roadblock in Pantagruels path. However, The peoples army would quickly give in to Pantagruels demands, knowing that this would be the only way to save their split and crumbling faction. This would allow the UDF to successfully form as a reformation of the APA, but no tribal cooperation would ensue. The tribal leaders would vow to die rather than sign into the UDF.

With the tribal militias still retaining independence from the confederacy, the UDF and PDF would most likely have a much harder time executing their plans, but if the lilypad offensive still went ahead, the following events would follow:

[i]
Pantagrueli intelligence would be outdated as of the date of the offensive. Within recent days, the lower islands had been successfully captured by tribal forces, driving the restorationists back into their stronghold island and their mainland territory. This would result in the operation accidentally targeting the tribal militias, instead of the restorationists, yet the UDF would be able to make no distinction between the two until it was too late, and the operation would therefore continue.

The amphibious assault would largely go undetected, until the point when the UDF would fire. As Nordiheimian-provided naval ships made routine surveillance routes around the islands, they would be detected by Pantagruels radar devices and subsequently fired upon as the ships approached the UDFs location, unaware of the hidden force. With 1 ship hit, the command centres back on the islands would be notified of the situation. Additionally, requests for assistance would be sent directly to Nordiheim. The lower amount of anti-air and naval equipment provided to the lower islands would lead to them using naval forces simply to buy time, whilst they waited for Nordiheim to arrive. On the island, troops and battle tanks would be readied on the coastline in preparation for the assault that would come.

The missiles launched would reach their targets on the tribal-inhabited lower islands with little resistance. The lack of anti-air systems provided by Nordiheim would allow the missiles to hit all targets successfully, crippling the islands infrastructure, yet also crippling the UDFs chance of cooperating with the tribes.

The aardvarks would further pummel the tribal population and infrastructure as there would be no effective counter to the guided munitions.

As the amphibious landing began, the tribes could only pray that the Nordiheimians would receive their call for help, whilst standing their ground and buying time for the Nordiheimian navy. The drake 2D battle tanks would roll onto the beaches to take on the UDF, whilst machine gunners and snipers would take aim from behind.  Whilst this unfolded, troops would continue to be diverted from around the islands to the various amphibious landing sites.

Now it would simply be a waiting game
[/i]
